sections.title: Abu Dhabi ends with a prisoner deal
sections.body: Russia and Ukraine agreed on the war's largest prisoner exchange, more than 1,000 per side, as two days of talks ended. Ukraine reported progress on security guarantees; territory is unresolved.

sections.title: US envoys take the plan to Putin
sections.body: Witkoff and Kushner flew to Moscow on 12 November with an updated proposal, then go to Dublin to brief Zelensky and European leaders, who remain outside the talks.

sections.title: Iran's reach into Britain
sections.body: The US charged three Iran-backed operatives over a plot at RAF Fairford. Treasury Secretary Bessent reportedly moved to a military base over Iranian threats; France summoned Iran's ambassador.

sections.title: Spy cases on NATO's eastern edge
sections.body: British police arrested a US Army member on suspicion of spying for Russia. Russia's FSB says it caught Polish agents in Kaliningrad; Warsaw calls it disinformation.

sections.title: Ukrainian drones over the Baltics
sections.body: Drones on their way to Ust-Luga strayed over Lithuania and Estonia. NATO jets were scrambled but did not down them, and Estonia asked Kyiv for an explanation.

sections.title: Strikes continue around the talks
sections.body: Russia hit Kyiv with a ballistic missile and 123 drones after the talks; two Russian cruise missiles crossed Moldova. Ukraine struck Omsk, Russia's largest refinery, and Ust-Luga.

key_developments: Abu Dhabi talks deliver a prisoner exchange of more than 1,000 per side, with no deal on territory.
Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Moscow to put an updated proposal to Putin.
US indictment names an Iran-backed plot at RAF Fairford; France summons Iran's ambassador.
A US Army member is arrested in Britain on suspicion of spying for Russia.
Ukrainian drones stray into Lithuanian and Estonian airspace; NATO jets fail to bring one down.
EU ambassadors back sanctions on 145 Russia-linked targets, including 50 banks; ministers vote 16 November.
since_last_visit_brief: The Abu Dhabi talks ended with a large prisoner exchange but no territorial deal, and US envoys flew to Moscow to meet Putin.
